body.statement: For independent and identically distributed observations, if a scalar estimator is regular and asymptotically linear with mean-zero, finite-variance influence function \(U\), then its centered \(\sqrt n\)-scaled error converges to a mean-zero normal law with variance \(\operatorname{Var}(U)\).

source.locator: Section 3, asymptotic-linearity display and immediately following normal-limit display; Appendix A, equations (33)--(34)
source.verbatim_statement: The RAL estimator is \(\sqrt n\)-consistent and asymptotically normal, with asymptotic variance equal to the variance of its influence function.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Section 3 of the JMLR version and checked against Appendix A, equations (33)--(34).
